about_the_game:
Space Cat Solitaire is a puzzle card game adventure set in a euphoric 80s-inspired retro-future. With cats.

It's solitaire reimagined! Space Cat Solitaire turns the classic solitaire formula on its head with three key ingredients: Agency, Purpose, and Style.

A Game of Skill, not Chance

Most hands are winnable if you're clever enough! Whether you choose a walk-in-the-park or a devious challenge is completely up to you! Unlimited undos give you the flexibility to retry any deal.

Win Fabulous Prizes

Get rewarded for your work! Unlock trophies for completing special challenges, or spend your earnings on customizations for your very own space kitten! The most elite cadets will even be offered exciting story-driven missions for the zany denizens of the Whiskerfang Expanse.

Enjoy The Journey

From the relaxing sights and sounds of reorganizing your cards, to the unleashing of a massive combo, to the fanfare of a victory, every moment is like basking in a warm sunbeam.

A Supernova of Content

  • 3 unique & refreshing variants of solitaire (this ain't your grandma's solitaire)

  • Multiple difficulties per variant for a wide range of players

  • Modifier modes ("purrallel universes") for even greater challenges and greater rewards

  • Player stats & charts to record your triumphs. Share (or brag) to your friends (and their cats)!

  • Unlockable trophies and cosmetics to customize your very own Space Kitten!

  • Story-driven missions: unique unlockable episodic challenges following Space Kitten's first big adventure in space

  • Space. And cats. And solitaire.

name: Space Cat Solitaire
short_description: Stack, organize and pros-purr! Hone your puzzling skills as you create epic combos, beat your high score and find your fortune among the stars! Use your wits & your winnings to unlock customizations, trophies, and elite story-driven missions featuring the eccentric locals of the Whiskerfang Expanse.
